description: Look up raw TCGplayer USD, Cardmarket EUR, PSA 9, PSA 10, and BGS 9.5 graded prices for Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and Sports cards by name or card number (e.g. "Charizard", "4/102", "Umbreon", "Blue-Eyes White Dragon").

limit.description: Maximum number of matching cards to return (1 to 10, default 5)

query.description: Card name, character, set name, or printed number (e.g. "Charizard 4/102", "Moonbreon", "LOB-001")

name: lookup_tcg_card_market_price
